newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate eases to 10.9 from 11.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate eases to 10.9 from 11.9 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate dropped to 10.9 percent on Thursday from 11.9 on lower demand for kuna funds.
Trade shrank to 17.5 million kuna from 39.1 on Wednesday and was mostly accounted for by banks' call money borrowings.

The central bank calculated the kuna mid-rates for Friday stronger at 5.6510 from 5.6811 to the dollar and very slightly firmer at 3.5570 against the mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
